Privacy & advertising

Learning progress, bookmarks, selected language and appearance are stored in your browser using localStorage. There is no learner account or cloud progress database. Clear this site’s browser data to remove it.

Advertising paused

Third-party advertising is currently disabled following a report of a deceptive security-warning advertisement. This site does not load ad scripts, display ad frames, open advertisement popups or require a timed advertisement before opening a book.

Audio & external links

Daily-word pronunciation uses bundled MP3 clips where available. Other Japanese pronunciation uses your browser’s speech synthesis service. Depending on your device, that service may operate locally or through its provider. External translation and source links open third-party websites only when selected.

Learning data

Learning content is bundled with the website. The interface offers Bengali and English. Bengali text is displayed only when its exact field has matching semantic-review evidence. Other fields use the English source with a pending label. Historical machine drafts remain in the corpus for continued review and are hidden in the learning interface. AI semantic checks are not native-speaker or teacher certification. Japanese and English sources may also contain errors.
